title: Kraken output hygiene
about: Mechanical clean-up that matters for any manuscript read with Kraken: one encoding per letter, no stray spaces or brackets, Latin hallucinations over blank or ruled areas.

rules.msg: Same letter, two encodings: use the single-character form (helps training)
Space at the start or end of the line
Latin words: probably a Kraken hallucination (check the image; blank the line if nothing is written)
